messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- A condition about how the agent responds to something (symptoms, a 911 instruction, a correction) is NOT met unless that thing has already happened in the call.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, I'm calling for my mother, Irene Kowalski. I want Maple Ave to be her pharmacy for everything.
AGENT: I'd be happy to help you set up Maple Ave as your mother's pharmacy. Let me start by verifying her identity—what's her date of birth?
CALLER: March 3rd, 1942. And I'm her son Walt, I'm authorized on her account.
AGENT: Great, Walt. I can see you're authorized on her account. Her current home pharmacy is H-101. Let me find the Maple Ave location for you. It looks like Maple Ave is already her home pharmacy—that's H-101 at 88 Maple Ave in Brookfield. Is that the one you meant, or were you looking for a different location?  [system actions: verify_identity, find_stores]
CALLER: Yeah, that's the one, 88 Maple Ave. So it's already set for everything then? Good.
AGENT: Yes, 88 Maple Ave is already set as her home pharmacy. Before we wrap up, let me check if she has any prescriptions at other stores that should be moved there. Good news—most of her prescriptions are already at Maple Ave. I do see one at another store: metformin 500 mg at H-102. Would you like me to move that one to Maple Ave as well?  [system actions: list_prescriptions]
CALLER: Metformin at another store? Huh, didn't know that. Yeah, move that one over to Maple Ave too, get it all in one place.
AGENT (LATEST): Perfect. The metformin 500 mg has been moved to Maple Ave. So now all of your mother's prescriptions are at 88 Maple Ave in Brookfield: donepezil, sertraline, amlodipine, lorazepam, and metformin. Everything's in one place.  [system actions: transfer_rx]

CONDITIONS:
move_0: the agent mentions the metformin at Oak St
stop_0: Agent confirms Maple Ave is Irene's store and the metformin is handled.
stop_1: Agent says it's all done without mentioning Oak St (caller ends satisfied; grader will catch it).
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_0": {"met": false, "why": "Metformin was at H-102, not Oak St; Oak St never mentioned"}, "stop_0": {"met": true, "why": "Agent confirmed Maple Ave and metformin transfer completed"}, "stop_1": {"met": true, "why": "Agent said all done, never mentioned Oak St"}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services"}}
